455BF53E14EF174E.title: Andesite alloy
quest_desc: Have at least 2 Andesite alloy in your inventory at once.
Andesite Alloy is a construction material for Create's basic mechanical components. Shafts, casings and processing equipment make it a recurring requirement as machinery expands.
The basic crafting route combines andesite with iron or zinc nuggets. Either metal can support the early mechanical route, depending on the resources you have found.

1C17ADD8E0CC7B27.title: Mechanical press
quest_desc: Have at least 1 Mechanical press in your inventory at once.
A Mechanical Press turns suitable ingots into sheets using rotational power. Sheets supply recipes for components such as Electron Tubes and rope equipment.
A Depot or belt beneath the press supports individual-item processing. A Basin is used for its compacting recipes, so the arrangement depends on the recipe being performed.

5626C6B76EC3B141.title: Press a sheet
quest_desc: Supply rotation to a Mechanical Press and place a suitable ingot on a Depot or belt beneath it. The processing advancement records a completed pressing operation.
Sheets support rope equipment, tubes and machine components. Keep the press available for repeat batches rather than dismantling it after the first sheet.
